What we do for businesses

Business photoshoots in our studio, and on location at your premises. From a single portrait to a whole photo day.

  • LinkedIn and profile photosA new LinkedIn photo that looks professional and real. Also for your website, email signature and CV.
  • Product photosPhotos of your products in our studio, for your webshop, catalogue and social media.
  • Team photos and staff portraitsThe whole team in one day, in the studio or at the office, with a consistent look.
  • Personal brandingFor freelancers, coaches and entrepreneurs: a set of photos for your website, About page and social media.
  • Website and atmosphere photosImages of your workplace, way of working and team, so visitors see who you are straight away.
  • Social media contentOne photo day for weeks of images on LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook.

Also think of

Business is broader than a profile photo. A few ideas for which businesses use us or can use us.

  • Job application and CV photosA polished photo for your job application, CV or professional profile.
  • Hairdressers, salons and beautyPortfolio and atmosphere images of your work, your salon and your team.
  • Hospitality and shopsPhotos of dishes, products, your interior and the people behind them.
  • Healthcare, advice and servicesTrustworthy portraits for doctors, estate agents, lawyers, coaches and advisers.
  • Company eventsA report of your event, drinks or anniversary, with atmosphere and portraits.
  • New employeesA quick portrait for every new colleague, in the same style as the rest.

Business shoots in our studio

Calm, with professional lighting, and everything arranged in one day.

In our photo studio in Poeldijk we make your LinkedIn photo, your product photos or the portraits of your team. We think along about backdrop, clothing and style. Are you a photographer yourself or do you have your own team? Then you can also hire the studio.

  1. Tell us what you need

Our parent company

More than photos: Kijk62

Kijk62 is our parent company and works with business clients. It is all about performing better on social media, from photo and video content to complete management.

Do you want more than just good photos? Kijk62 supports business clients with everything that comes with it, so your brand is recognisable and consistently visible online.

We make the images in our studio, Kijk62 makes sure they do their job on your channels. That way you have everything at one address in Poeldijk.

  • Images and contentPhotos and videos that fit your brand.
  • Management of your channelsFrom copy and scheduling to reporting.

Questions about business shoots

What does a business shoot cost?

That depends on the number of people, the type of photos and the location. Request a no-obligation quote.

Can I have a new LinkedIn photo made?

Ja, dat doen we in onze studio in Poeldijk. Lees ook ons artikel over een zakelijke portretfoto voor LinkedIn.

Do you also make product photos?

Yes, in our studio we photograph products for your webshop, catalogue and social media.

Can you do a whole team in one day?

Yes. With the mobile studio set we photograph everyone efficiently at your own location, or we welcome you in the studio.

Can I use the photos anywhere?

You get the photos in high quality for print, website and social media.

What is the difference between Photostudio62 and Kijk62?

Photostudio62 makes the photos. Kijk62 is our parent company and works with business clients and their social media. Together you arrange the images and the visibility.

Can I also simply hire the studio?

Ja. Bekijk de pagina studio hire voor tarieven en voorwaarden.
